events.factual_description: The GRAMMY Museum presents A New York Evening With Neko Case at National Sawdust in Brooklyn on Thursday, October 8, 2026 at 7:30 PM, with check-in/doors at 6:30 PM. The GRAMMY Museum and National Sawdust describe the program as a celebration and discussion with Case, moderated by writer Hanif Abdurraqib, about her music, creative process, career and more, followed by a special live performance. The venue lists the performance as seated and gives the address as 80 North 6th St, Brooklyn, NY 11249. National Sawdust links directly to an authorized Universe ticket destination. The event pages connect the discussion to Case's album Neon Grey Midnight Green; ANTI- Records and Apple Music verify the album title and September 26, 2025 release date. No stable public face-value ticket price or additional performing personnel are exposed on the verified surfaces, so none are inferred. National Sawdust's page contains a stale 'event has passed' module despite also labeling the October 8, 2026 event upcoming; the current GRAMMY Museum calendar independently lists the future date and tickets.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care about this date is the format, not simply another Neko Case stop. Hanif Abdurraqib sits down with one of alternative music's most distinctive songwriters for a conversation about the work and the process, then the discussion gives way to a live performance. With Neon Grey Midnight Green still framing Case's current creative cycle, the National Sawdust evening turns listening into a direct exchange between songs, authorship and criticism. If New York is in play, actively make room for it.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is already in play, build the Brooklyn evening around National Sawdust. From the DMV, I would pair this compact conversation-and-performance program with another strong reason to be in the city rather than make a dedicated round trip solely for it.

es.why_it_matters: La razón para fijarse en esta fecha es el formato, no simplemente otra parada de Neko Case. Hanif Abdurraqib conversa con una de las compositoras más singulares de la música alternativa sobre la obra y el proceso creativo, y después la conversación desemboca en una actuación en vivo. Con Neon Grey Midnight Green todavía marcando el ciclo creativo actual de Case, la noche en National Sawdust convierte la escucha en un intercambio directo entre canciones, autoría y crítica. Si Nueva York está en juego, sí le haría espacio activamente.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York ya está en juego, armaría la noche de Brooklyn alrededor de National Sawdust. Desde el DMV combinaría este programa compacto de conversación y música con otra razón fuerte para estar en la ciudad, en vez de hacer un viaje dedicado de ida y vuelta únicamente por esta función.
